The heater now has a half-degree band either side of the target, and replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12: on at 04:26 (19.3°C) and off at 04:40 (20.6°C).

The setting is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, directly under `TARGET_C` in `greenhouse.py`. The heater switches off when the temperature reaches 20.5°C or above, and on when it reaches 19.5°C or below.

`heater_on` now takes a second argument, the relay's current state (`heater_on(temp_c, currently_on)`). Only `greenhouse.py` and the log are in this folder, so if the controller on the Pi is separate code, it needs the same change — and if it imports `heater_on` from this file, its call needs the extra argument or it will fail.
